purpose: Independent expectation layer for comparing B07 fixture definitions with E's interpretation.

independent_rules.pass: expected.violation_count=0 and required coverage is fully evaluated
independent_rules.block: missing coverage, unsupported definition, invalid core value, orphan, row mismatch or publication-integrity failure
independent_rules.fingerprint: SHA-256 of normalized FP1 JSON input excluding provenance/runtime values
independent_rules.source_year_coverage: every enabled source x every analysis year, including zero-crash years

comparison_targets.status: expectations prepared; execution must be recorded as separate evidence
